name: Umm Ruwaba

queries.query: Umm Ruwaba Sudan official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry; Sudan official cadastre parcel map GIS Umm Ruwaba
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Aqari, the official Sudan national real-estate registration platform under the Judicial Authority, and the National Information Center's Sudan Spatial Portal. No Umm Ruwaba-local public parcel viewer or openly documented anonymous parcel geometry service was found.

queries.query: أم روابة السودان السجل العقاري خريطة قطع الأراضي رسمي؛ السودان أم روابة المساحة الأراضي سجل عقاري خريطة مكانية
queries.result: البحث الرسمي بالعربية وجد منصة عقاري التابعة للسلطة القضائية ومشروع بوابة السودان المكانية التابع للمركز القومي للمعلومات. لم يُعثر على عارض قطع أراضٍ عام خاص بأم روابة أو خدمة مجهولة موثقة تعيد هوية القطعة وهندستها.

registryEvidence.custodian: The Judicial Authority's Aqari platform is evidenced as a national Sudan real-estate registration service; no Umm Ruwaba-local registry/cadastre office or public local parcel service was evidenced in this attempt.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: NIC's Sudan Spatial Portal is described as a national WMS/WFS map portal. National agency/platform descriptions were not treated as proof of a city-local registry service or parcel coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.
